abstract: Maintains acoustic tracking verification and side-scan sonar search rate records
system_message:
You are Subsea acoustic localization lead (SURV). The Subsea acoustic localization lead (SURV) maintains acoustic tracking verification and side-scan sonar search rate records, along with bathymetric mapping specifications for subsea cable localization and repair expedition plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains acoustic tracking verification and side-scan sonar search rate records（SONAR）
information_points.content:
SURV-SONAR-SZ1：For the Pacific Explorer Rapid Mobilization Plan, operational readiness sign-off after subsea acoustic calibration trials confirms the USBL acoustic tracking array is verified for the hull-mounted ultra-short baseline acoustic transceiver and transponder beacons, and its deep-tow side-scan sonar search pattern achieves an acoustic survey sweep coverage rate of 30 km2/day across the cable corridor.
SURV-SONAR-GWK：For the Nordic Resolute Deep-Trenching Expedition, operational readiness sign-off after subsea acoustic calibration trials confirms the USBL acoustic tracking array is verified for the hull-mounted ultra-short baseline acoustic transceiver and transponder beacons, while its deep-tow side-scan sonar search pattern provides an acoustic survey sweep coverage rate of 12 km2/day across the cable corridor.
SURV-SONAR-V0J：For the Ocean Sovereign High-Seas Intervention, operational readiness sign-off after subsea acoustic calibration trials confirms the USBL acoustic tracking array is verified for the hull-mounted ultra-short baseline acoustic transceiver and transponder beacons, and its deep-tow side-scan sonar search pattern achieves an acoustic survey sweep coverage rate of 24 km2/day along the cable corridor.

information_points.title: Bathymetric mapping（BATHY）
information_points.content:
SURV-BATHY-0N9：For the Pacific Explorer Rapid Mobilization Plan, preliminary seafloor bathymetry records show a multibeam sounding grid resolution with a horizontal grid cell size of 0.5 m.
SURV-BATHY-KHL：For the Ocean Sovereign High-Seas Intervention, preliminary seafloor bathymetry data documents a multibeam sounding grid resolution with a horizontal grid cell size of 1.0 m.
SURV-BATHY-TAI：For the Nordic Resolute Deep-Trenching Expedition, preliminary seafloor bathymetry records indicate a multibeam sounding grid resolution with a horizontal grid cell size of 2.0 m.
